data.message: I individually opt in to 18 tons this month, regardless of others; please consider 18 rather than 10—$8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and the rest 10, catch=250+8k, leaving 250−8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500−16k (25%). At k=25, 50 remain, then 500 or 100. This risks lower future income, not guaranteed optimality. Intentions aren't binding; other catches need recalculation. Each of the other 24: state your exact intended catch and whether it depends on others.
